basic_details.job_title: ARI Project Assistant (Nanobioscience) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Nanobioscience (Virology Laboratory) of MACS - Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, has invited applications for one temporary Project Assistant post under the project "Viral RNA and microRNA interactions" (ARI-026). The monthly stipend is Rs.20000/- + HRA (as applicable). The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Science in any branch of life science. Applications are online at http://arijob.ourlib.in from 18 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the online application link http://arijob.ourlib.in and apply on or before 02.12.2026.
Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned under Essential Qualification.
Attach a recent passport size photograph.
Attach a caste certificate issued by the competent authority, for reserved category candidates.

Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs.100/-, if applicable, online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/. The path given is Educational Institutions → Category → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee → enter the necessary fields/details.
Attach the fee receipt and write the online receipt number in the application form.
The Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed online fee transactions. Candidates should contact the concerned bank about these.

content_sections.heading: ARI Project Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: 50 Years as on closing date of advt.

content_sections.heading: About ARI
content_sections.text: MACS - Agharkar Research Institute is an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, located at G. G. Agarkar Road, Pune 411 004. The post is in its Nanobioscience (Virology Laboratory), where the Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Yogesh Karpe, Scientist E. The notice describes the position as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prescribes the following qualification for the Project Assistant post. The age limit is 50 Years as on closing date of advt. Relaxation applies for OBC, SC, ST etc. categories according to Govt of India regulations. The essential qualifications are minimum, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Whether a qualification is equivalent to the essential and desirable ones is decided by the committee constituted to scrutinise applications. For deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates, desirable qualifications may be relaxed at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor of Science in any branch of life science from a recognized university or equivalent
rows.desirable: Master in any branch of life science with First Class; experience in virology/animal cell culture techniques

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend is Rs.20000/- + HRA (as applicable). The position is purely on a contractual basis, and the project period runs up to 30.09.2027. Selected candidates may be assigned to another project based on Institutional requirement. They will have no right to appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post/s.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ARI Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Open the online application link http://arijob.ourlib.in and apply on or before 02.12.2026. Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned under Essential Qualification. Attach a recent passport size photograph. Attach a caste certificate issued by the competent authority, for reserved category candidates. Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs.100/-, if applicable, online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/ . The path given is Educational Institutions → Category → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee → enter the necessary fields/details. Attach the fee receipt and write the online receipt number in the application form. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed online fee transactions. Candidates should contact the concerned bank about these.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by online interview. If a large number of applications is received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for interview through a shortlisting process. The criterion may include desirable qualifications and/or experience beyond that prescribed, and/or qualifications or experience in a particular field. The shortlist and the day, date and time of the online interview will be displayed on the Institute website. Candidates may appear for the interview in Hindi as well. No T.A. is admissible for interviews.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant vacancies are there at ARI?
faq.answer: There is one Project Assistant post, a temporary position under ARI-026 in the Nanobioscience (Virology Laboratory).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ARI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 2 December 2026 (02.12.2026). Applications opened on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ARI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor of Science in any branch of life science from a recognized university or equivalent. A Master in any branch of life science with First Class is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ARI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 Years as on the closing date of the advertisement. OBC, SC, ST etc. categories get relaxation according to Govt of India regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of ARI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs.20000/- + HRA (as applicable).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs.100/-, paid online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/. SC/ST/Divyang/Women Candidates are excepted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ARI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Apply through the online link http://arijob.ourlib.in on or before 02.12.2026. Attach the self-attested certificates, passport size photograph, caste certificate for reserved category and the fee receipt if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by online interview. The Institute may shortlist candidates if many applications arrive, and the shortlist and interview schedule will be displayed on the Institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ARI Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely on a contractual basis, with the project period up to 30.09.2027. Selected candidates have no right to appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post/s.

faq.question: Q10. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: The notice prints the stipend as Rs.20000/- + HRA (as applicable), so HRA is mentioned in addition to the Rs.20000/- stipend.
